provenance: Real output of the git command resolveHeadFlag in src/gates/merge-preconditions.ts runs, captured 2026-09-23 by the M5-P3 fix-round-1 implementer in a scratch repository with one commit and a branch named Review-Head at it. Stored unedited: the sha in stdout is that scratch commit, recorded in staging.head. The two lowercased spellings are what the pre-M5-P3 code handed git; they name no commit, exit 1 and print nothing. test/merge-preconditions.test.ts re-runs all four in a staged repository and requires the same exit codes and the same stdout shape before trusting the gate.
